packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: auto-merge minor + patch after passing CI
Helm charts: separate dashboard entries per chart (high-touch)
Kubernetes base images / sidecar images: 7-day soak

Base/sidecar image DIGEST refreshes (same tag, rebuilt image = the CVE-patch stream): auto-merge after the 7-day soak + passing CI, WITHOUT dashboard approval. This is the H-4.7 cadence fix — pure digest bumps were piling up unmerged behind the manual approval above, leaving running images stale despite pinDigests. Version (major/minor/patch) bumps still require dashboard approval via the rule above; this only relaxes same-tag digest refreshes. Consistent with the existing github-actions digest auto-merge. Merge is repo-only — the cluster is rolled separately (see docs/03-runbooks/base-image-cve-cadence.md). To revert to fully-manual, set automerge:false.

Keycloak base image — operator review before merge. Both version and digest updates surface on the dependency dashboard and merge only on operator approval; merging runs the keycloak-image-build pipeline, then the CR digest is cut over by hand (operator-backlog #48).
SecLists HIBP password blacklist: yearly cadence is fine
node_modules in any TS project — security PRs immediately, others batched weekly
k3s + Kubernetes version: never auto-bump; gated by maintenance window

jwx: major (v3/v4) updates disabled — security-critical JWT/DPoP code in apps/lib/api-auth; the migration is parked + tracked in operator-backlog #44 (revisit ~2026-07-21). v2 minor/patch updates still flow normally. To resume, set enabled to true (or delete this rule).
Wazuh SIEM images: coordinated multi-image upgrade — own dashboard entry, not folded into the non-major sweep. See operator-backlog #45.

Platform Helm charts (tracked via the per-component CHART_VER customManagers below + MinIO): each surfaces on the dependency dashboard for operator approval, with a 3-day soak. High-touch cluster infra — never auto-merged.

ingress-nginx chart is being retired (ADR-0032 — replaced by the Istio gateway; Deployment scaled to 0). Its CHART_VER manager is kept for completeness, but updates are disabled so a decommissioned component does not generate noise PRs. Delete this rule to resume tracking if the retirement is reversed.

Istio service mesh: own dashboard entry, never folded into the group:allNonMajor sweep. One ISTIO_CHART_VER drives base/istiod/cni/ztunnel under the public + tailnet gateways and the Ambient HBONE paths, so mesh bumps must be reviewed and rolled in isolation (maintenance window; istiod before dataplane). Mirrors the wazuh/keycloak separation.

customManagers.description: Keycloak version + base-image digest in the custom Dockerfile. matchStringsStrategy 'combination' builds one dependency from the KEYCLOAK_VERSION (currentValue) and KEYCLOAK_BASE_DIGEST (currentDigest) ARGs, so Renovate can apply both version and digest updates rather than only the digest.
SecLists HIBP blacklist commit pin in Keycloak Dockerfile

cert-manager Helm chart version (CERT_MANAGER_CHART_VER) in 00b-cert-manager.sh. Tracks the cert-manager chart in https://charts.jetstack.io. Replaces the old generic CHART_VER manager, which expected an inline `helm --chart` on the next line and so silently matched nothing (the scripts call a install-helm.sh wrapper). Per-chart managers are the only reliable pattern here — operator-backlog #55 / #56.

ingress-nginx Helm chart version (INGRESS_NGINX_CHART_VER) in 00c-ingress-nginx.sh. Tracks the ingress-nginx chart in https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx. NOTE: update PRs are disabled via a packageRule above (chart is being retired — ADR-0032).

Istio Helm chart version (ISTIO_CHART_VER) in 06-istio.sh. One version drives all four sub-charts (base, istiod, cni, ztunnel) installed from https://istio-release.storage.googleapis.com/charts — they ship as one release train, so tracking the 'base' chart is sufficient to bump the shared ISTIO_CHART_VER.
Tempo Helm chart version (TEMPO_CHART_VER) in 07b-tempo.sh. Tracks the tempo chart in https://grafana.github.io/helm-charts.
OpenTelemetry Collector Helm chart version (OTEL_CHART_VER) in 07c-otel-collector.sh. Tracks the opentelemetry-collector chart in https://open-telemetry.github.io/opentelemetry-helm-charts.
kube-prometheus-stack Helm chart version (KPS_CHART_VER) in 07e-prometheus.sh. Tracks the kube-prometheus-stack chart in https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts.
Loki Helm chart version (LOKI_CHART_VER) in 07f-loki.sh. Tracks the loki chart in https://grafana.github.io/helm-charts.
Promtail Helm chart version (PROMTAIL_CHART_VER) in 07g-promtail.sh. Tracks the promtail chart in https://grafana.github.io/helm-charts.
Velero Helm chart version (VELERO_CHART_VER) in 09a-velero.sh. Tracks the velero chart in https://vmware-tanzu.github.io/helm-charts.
Kyverno Helm chart version (KYVERNO_CHART_VER) in 12-kyverno.sh. Tracks the kyverno chart in https://kyverno.github.io/kyverno.
Trivy Operator Helm chart version (TRIVY_OPERATOR_CHART_VER) in 13-trivy-operator.sh. Tracks the trivy-operator chart in https://aquasecurity.github.io/helm-charts.

MinIO Helm chart version (MINIO_CHART_VER) in 07a-minio.sh. Tracks the minio chart in https://charts.min.io. (Operator-backlog #55 / #56 — MinIO had gone 17 months stale before explicit tracking was added; the other platform charts shared the same blind spot, now closed by the per-chart managers above.)
